phase1.evidence: Static code (lead L-018): LDA #$00 / CLC / ADC #$20 / STA $8364 / AND #$C0 / ORA #$18 / STA PPUMASK / RTS. The STA target $8364 is its own LDA operand at this exact address (self-modifying emphasis-bit cycler), an encoded origin anchoring the instruction stream at $8363; between RTS-ended observed code and FS_PlayerLogic. From ROM the store is an MMC1 write, so it cannot work as written here. Reachability: no reference, no observed fetch (unreferenced).

units.name: FS_UnusedEmphasisCycle
units.summary: No static reference or pointer to it was found (treated as unused; reachability is not proven). It adds $20 to the immediate operand of its own LDA ($8364), keeps bits 6-7 of the sum and writes them with BG/sprites enabled ($18) to PPUMASK, so repeated calls from RAM would cycle the emphasis bits. From ROM the operand store has no effect and every call writes plain $18. Probably a debug or develop

units.name: DR_DrawSpeedBar

units.name: IrqHandler
units.summary: DMC-timed raster interrupt. NMI restarts a short DMC sample with IRQ enabled; each IRQ re-arms the sample and counts IrqCountdown down. When it underflows, the next entry of the split tables (index IrqSplitIndex, step 2) supplies the Y parameter, the next countdown and an RTS-dispatch target (IrqSplitHandlers) that rewrites the scroll/PPUCTRL and then jumps to IrqSplitDone. Reachability: static on

phase1.evidence: Static code (lead L-007): raster IRQ split common tail; target of JMP $C036 in the three split handlers; IrqSplitIndex += 2, at $0E stops DMC (STA $4015 #$0F), falls into established epilogue $C048. Reachability: IrqHandler never observed (static only).

units.name: IrqSplitDone
units.summary: Common tail of every split handler: step IrqSplitIndex to the next table entry. After the last split (index $0E) APU_STATUS = $0F turns the DMC channel off, so no further raster IRQs occur until NMI re-arms the sample next frame.

units.summary: Shared NMI body (every bank's NMI vector jumps here through its $8006 stub). editorial_audit.notes: Final acceptance on pass-005 (targeted checks, prior review credit reused; no whole-source reread). Checks: raw numeric operands, auto/address labels, stale unknown/Text/padding/not-proven prose, unit-vs-label and label-vs-map boundaries, name collisions and name/kind contradictions, repeated comments, unused-code certainty. Fixed: (1) stale numeric aliases: reset-stub JSR $CF10/JMP $CF24 in banks 0-6 now InitRecords/WarmStart; bank 5 CL_InitBracket table reads now CL_BracketHandlers-2/-1 (was $93DB and the unrelated CL_InitBracketRts); bank 6 DV_OutcomeTable-12; bank 2 self-modifying store FS_UnusedEmphasisCycle+1; bank 7 pause banner reads of $04AD now DvVaultPhase (generic Var04AD removed) with corrected 7-record banner description; WarmStart JMP $8000 annotated. (2) wrong boundaries: 21 code units no longer swallow trailing data/padding/vectors (e.g. B0-B6_Reset 170->35 B). (3) misleading certainty: two 'unused, unreferenced' routines reworded as treated-as-unused, reachability not proven. (4) missing space before trailing comments on long lines. (5) missing structures: the first audit run failed (code region lacks reviewed units: region-6) because units were attached only to the scaffold row holding their start; 847 continuation Code rows now carry split inventory records of their covering routine (same name, clipped extent, summary + source). Remaining explained uncertainties are in uncertainties.md (generic data without consumers, L-004 reachability, L-005/L-006 roles, IrqHandler unobserved). Tool changes are workspace-local (commentary/tools: build_source.py ~ADDR operand directive; update_review.py code-unit trim).
